name: Monarch Money
summary: Personal budgeting app with an AI assistant.
description: Monarch brings accounts, cards and investments together to track spending, budget and net worth, alone or as a couple. Its AI assistant answers questions about your finances and spots trends.
summary_fr: Application de budget personnel avec assistant IA.
description_fr: Monarch regroupe comptes, cartes et placements pour suivre dépenses, budget et patrimoine, seul ou en couple. Son assistant IA répond aux questions sur tes finances et repère des tendances.
